findings.source_quote: I will hasten to say that I don’t think this is the ‘mark of the beast’
findings.suggested_fix: The literal rendering 'Je me hâte de dire' is understandable but non‑idiomatic in French. Suggest a more idiomatic phrasing that preserves meaning, e.g. « Je tiens à dire rapidement que je ne crois pas que ceci soit la ‘marque de la bête’ ». Apply similar smoothing where 'I will hasten to say' recurs.
findings.translation_quote: Je me hâte de dire que je ne pense pas que ceci soit la « marque de la bête »

findings.source_quote: for clarity it is better to call it a flu shot.
findings.suggested_fix: The translation uses « vaccin antigrippal ». That is accurate, but consider matching the source's informal 'flu shot' register with « le vaccin contre la grippe » or « l’antigrippal » if tighter register is desired. Either is acceptable; no doctrinal change is needed.
findings.translation_quote: il vaut mieux l’appeler un vaccin antigrippal
